name: The Tower of Remembering
visual_description: A solid bastion of memory. Its windows flicker with glimpses of faces long gone, held like ghosts in crystalline ribs.
meaning: Archive. The weight of what once was.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh locked emotion here.** I return when I want to hurt, when I want to remind myself *they were real.* This tower still mourns in silence for me.
